milestones.title: Taxonomy, baseline + LLM extraction, trend views, stats endpoints
evidence: Taxonomy: config/skills.yaml (336 skills, 10 role families) with a validating loader; duplicate ids/aliases rejected.
Baseline: deterministic word-boundary alias matcher with negation, nice-to-have required flags and multilingual normalisation.

LLM: provider-agnostic structured extractor with taxonomy validation, once-only JSON retry and prompt-injection isolation; the real OpenAI-compatible adapter (providers.py) is gated off by default, key only from SKILLPULSE_LLM_API_KEY, and fails closed without a shared atomic Redis daily budget; on failure the service stores the baseline flagged as fallback (offline baseline always usable).
Persistence: migration 0002 adds post_extractions, post_skills, skill_trend_mv and skill_segment_mv (unique indexes for CONCURRENTLY refresh; 3-state remote_state so remote=false excludes unknown).

Trends: exact numerator/denominator per month and segment; total_posts is eligible posts for the requested extractor/taxonomy (not full-source coverage, which /v1/coverage reports); shares withheld below 30 posts.
Stats API on FastAPI: /healthz, /readyz, /v1/skills/top, /v1/skills/{id}/trend, /v1/coverage.
Labelled synthetic set of 40 posts (eval/datasets/synthetic_extraction.json); baseline micro-F1 0.9910 / macro-F1 0.9783 recorded in eval/results/baseline_synthetic.json (synthetic, not real data).
Integration tests run the real Postgres 16 migration, the CONCURRENTLY refresh and the real endpoints.

worker-skills is wired: skillpulse workers/skills run bounded, idempotent extraction batches via the default-closed provider factory and the shared Redis budget, and a nightly beat task refreshes the trend views in AUTOCOMMIT.
remaining_gates: Real-LLM F1 (S2 >= 0.85) and the real-HN labelled set (~150 posts) are BLOCKED: the LLM gate is off and no provider credential/base URL is configured, and labelling real HN post text needs the M1 authorization gate.
The baseline-vs-LLM table cannot be completed until both real runs exist; the synthetic baseline F1 is not a real-data S2 result.
milestones.spec_acceptance: Extraction set labelled: synthetic set done, real-HN set NOT done. Baseline vs LLM F1 recorded (S2): baseline on synthetic recorded, real LLM F1 NOT recorded.

milestones.title: Tools module, LangGraph agent, grounding check, /v1/ask, fixture DB, agent eval
evidence: skillpulse.tools: the five read-only tools (search_jobs, skill_counts, skill_trend, compare_skills, match_cv) with typed bounded Pydantic arguments, fixed parameterized SQL (no model-written SQL and no raw-SQL escape hatch), content-addressed result_id values, eligible-post denominator semantics, 3-state remote and the <30-post share suppression.

Read-only tool sessions set READ ONLY/PRAGMA query_only plus a statement timeout and row cap; migration 0003 adds the NOLOGIN skillpulse_readonly Postgres role with SELECT only (no embedded credential).

LangGraph agent (plan -> tools -> draft -> grounding check) with max 6 tool calls, one rewrite and a wall-clock deadline; a configurable OpenAI-compatible model path reuses the M3 client and the shared Redis budget and is off by default.
Grounding fails closed on fabricated citations and only typed share/rate fields prove a percent; structured claims are validated against the exact field path and rendered from it.
POST /v1/ask streams SSE plan/tool_call/tool_result/token/done(trace_id,partial,grounded)/error, cancels on disconnect, returns 503 for Postgres down and never returns internal errors or credentials.

Deterministic SQLite fixture DB (no post text) and eval/datasets/agent_cases.json (9 cases: grounded statistics, ambiguity, impossible Greek, injection, invented numbers, tool failure, cancellation); fake-model fixture result 9/9 correct, grounding 1.0, tool selection 1.0 recorded in eval/results/agent_fixture_fake.json.
remaining_gates: Real-model S3 (answer correctness >= 0.85) and S4 (grounding >= 0.98) need SKILLPULSE_AGENT_LLM_ENABLED with an OpenAI-compatible base URL/model and a shared Redis budget; none supplied, so only the fake-model fixture run exists and it is not a real-model number.
Hosted /v1/ask and the MCP client checks (S8) need the M5/M6 deployment.
milestones.spec_acceptance: Baseline recorded: fixture fake-model baseline recorded (correctness 1.0, grounding 1.0 over 9 cases). S3 and S4 measured with a real model: NOT met (no credential/budget supplied).

remaining_gates: Implement the stdio and streamable HTTP MCP transports over the existing tool module, plus the skillpulse://taxonomy resource.
